title: 3-page interactive Happy Birthday website with animations and playful tone

requirements.text: Implement a 3-page, mobile-responsive birthday website with smooth fade/slide transitions between pages and clear navigation controls: Page 1 shows only a “Next Page” button when unlocked; Pages 2 and 3 must always include a visible “Previous Page” button and also include a “Next Page” button where specified.

quotes: Create a 3-page interactive Happy Birthday website.
Smooth fade/slide transitions.
Mobile responsive layout.
Each page must include a visible “Previous Page” button (except Page 1).

acceptanceCriteria: There are exactly 3 distinct pages/screens with route-based navigation (or equivalent) and animated transitions between them.
Page 1 does not show a “Previous Page” button.
Page 2 shows “Previous Page” and “Next Page” buttons.
Page 3 shows a “Previous Page” button; Page 3 does not require a “Next Page” button.
Layout adapts cleanly to common mobile widths (e.g., 360px) without overflowing text/buttons.

requirements.text: Apply the global visual design consistently across all pages: soft pink/peach/warm-golden gradients, elegant rounded modern typography, deep black readable text, subtle sparkles, floating balloons (where specified), and confetti used only during celebration moments.

quotes:
GLOBAL DESIGN:

• Soft pink, peach, and warm golden gradients.
• Elegant rounded modern fonts.
• Deep black readable text.
• Smooth fade/slide transitions.
• Floating balloons and subtle sparkles.
• Confetti only on celebration moments.

acceptanceCriteria: All pages use gradient backgrounds in the specified palette and maintain high readability with deep black text.
Typography uses a rounded, modern style across headings/body and remains consistent between pages.
Sparkles are subtle and do not impair readability.
Confetti appears only on (a) Page 1 reveal click and (b) Page 3 gentle fall after the specified delay; no constant confetti background effect.

requirements.text:
Build Page 1 (“GRAND BIRTHDAY ENTRY”) with: a soft glowing pink-peach gradient background; floating balloons that slowly move upward; centered text that starts as “Hey You 🌸
Guess what day it is?” and automatically fades after 2 seconds into “It’s not just a date.
It’s a national-level event.”; a large button labeled “Reveal the Birthday Girl 👀”. On click: trigger a confetti burst and a brief screen-glow animation, then reveal the message “Happy Birthday ✨
To someone who makes ordinary days better
just by existing.” and show a “Next Page” button.

quotes: PAGE 1 – GRAND BIRTHDAY ENTRY 🎉

Center text:

“Hey You 🌸  
Guess what day it is?”

After 2 seconds, text fades into:

“It’s not just a date.  
It’s a national-level event.”

Big Button:
“Reveal the Birthday Girl 👀”

When clicked:
Confetti burst.
Screen glow animation.

Then show:

“Happy Birthday ✨  
To someone who makes ordinary days better  
just by existing.”

Show “Next Page” button.

acceptanceCriteria: On Page 1 load, the first text is visible; at ~2 seconds it transitions (fade) to the second text.
Balloons animate upward continuously and subtly in the background.
Clicking “Reveal the Birthday Girl 👀” triggers a noticeable confetti burst and a short-lived glow overlay/animation.
After clicking, the birthday message appears and a “Next Page” button becomes visible and usable.
Confetti on Page 1 does not loop continuously; it is an event-based burst.

requirements.text: Add optional subtle background instrumental birthday music on Page 1 with safe defaults: do not autoplay audio by default; provide a small, unobtrusive play/pause control so users can opt-in to audio.

quotes: Subtle background instrumental birthday music (optional).

acceptanceCriteria: A play/pause control is available on Page 1 to enable/disable background music.
Music is not audible until the user explicitly starts playback.
Playback can be paused/stopped by the user.

requirements.text: Build Page 2 (“OFFICIAL BIRTHDAY REPORT”) with a cute animated newspaper/celebration-board aesthetic and the exact provided text content, including the “Charges” bullet list and “Verdict / Punishment” lines. Include a button labeled “Accept Birthday Flowers 🌷” that, when clicked, reveals a cute animated panda or kitten holding flowers and shows the message “Today, you don’t chase goals.\nYou receive flowers.” Include “Previous Page” and “Next Page” buttons.

quotes: PAGE 2 – OFFICIAL BIRTHDAY REPORT 📰

Theme:
Cute animated newspaper or celebration board aesthetic.

Title:

🎂 OFFICIAL BIRTHDAY REPORT 🎂

Name: batak  
Status: Another year cooler.  
Energy Level: Dangerous Cute.  
Achievement Unlocked: Level Up.

Witness Statement:
“She didn’t even try.  
She just kept being effortlessly nice.”

Charges:
• Stealing smiles
• Being calm but powerful
• Existing with too much grace

Verdict:
Guilty.

Punishment:
Must smile extra today.

Button:
“Accept Birthday Flowers 🌷”

When clicked:
Cute animated panda or kitten appears holding flowers.

Message below:

“Today, you don’t chase goals.  
You receive flowers.”

Show “Next Page” button.

acceptanceCriteria: Page 2 displays the title and all specified lines/sections exactly as provided, including “Name: batak”.
The page styling reads like a playful newspaper/board (e.g., paper card, subtle grain, pinned-note feel, or animated accents).
Clicking “Accept Birthday Flowers 🌷” reveals the panda/kitten-with-flowers visual and plays a simple “pop-in”/bounce animation.
After clicking the button, the message “Today, you don’t chase goals. You receive flowers.” is visible under the visual.
“Previous Page” and “Next Page” navigation is visible and functional.

requirements.text: Build Page 3 (“SOFT WISH PAGE”) with a warm golden-pink glow theme and a soft falling flower-petals animation. Display the provided multi-paragraph wish text and bullet list. After 3 seconds on the page, trigger a gentle confetti fall (time-based, not user-triggered). Show the final line “Happy Birthday.\nYou’re appreciated more than you realize.” and end with a softly glowing “The End” text. Include a visible “Previous Page” button.

quotes: PAGE 3 – SOFT WISH PAGE 🌸

Theme:
Warm golden-pink glow.
Soft falling flower petals animation.

Text:

“Birthdays are strange.

They don’t just count years.
They remind us how lucky the world was
the day you arrived.

May this year bring:
• Peace in your heart
• Confidence in your steps
• Success in your goals
• And small moments that make you quietly happy

Keep being kind.
Keep being steady.
Keep being you.

That’s more than enough.”

After 3 seconds:
Gentle confetti fall.

Final line:

“Happy Birthday.
You’re appreciated more than you realize.”

End screen with:
Soft glowing “The End” text.

acceptanceCriteria: Flower petals continuously fall in a subtle loop behind the text without harming readability.
At ~3 seconds after Page 3 becomes visible, a gentle confetti fall starts and then ends (not infinite).
All provided text appears on Page 3 with line breaks and bullet list formatting preserved for readability.
A softly glowing “The End” text is visible at the end of the content.
A visible “Previous Page” button navigates back to Page 2.

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets for the “panda or kitten holding flowers” reveal (Page 2) and any small sparkle/petal sprites used for animations; load them from frontend static assets (not from the backend).

quotes:
When clicked:
Cute animated panda or kitten appears holding flowers.
Floating balloons and subtle sparkles.
Soft falling flower petals animation.

acceptanceCriteria: The panda/kitten holding flowers uses a bundled static image (or images) served from the frontend (e.g., under frontend/public/assets/generated).
If sprites are used for sparkles/petals, they are bundled as static assets and render correctly on all pages.
No backend calls are required for displaying these visuals.

constraints: Do not edit any files under the immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose existing UI components instead).
Keep all functionality within the existing single-actor backend architecture; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not autoplay audio without explicit user interaction.
nonGoals: User accounts, Internet Identity login flows, or any authentication features.
Persisting user data or storing page state in the backend.

required: Cute panda holding a bouquet of flowers, clean vector-like style, pastel colors, transparent background (panda-flowers.dim_768x768.png)
Small sparkle particle sprite set, subtle golden-white sparkles on transparent background (sparkles-sprites.dim_512x512.png)
Soft flower petal sprite set, light pink/peach petals on transparent background (petals-sprites.dim_512x512.png)
Single balloon illustration (round balloon with string), pastel pink/peach on transparent background (balloon-single.dim_512x512.png)
